name: Order flow Model 2 on ETH and SOL 5m

history.reason: FAIL, rejected with Luke's say-so (2026-11-16). Fails test 1 on both coins by a wide margin: ETH 5m 2020-01 to 2025-10 -81%, Sharpe -3.67, 790 trades, 30% won, -0.68R a trade after costs (0.61R of costs); SOL 5m 2020-08 to 2025-10 -80%, Sharpe -3.42, 637 trades, 31% won, -0.73R (rerun after the spread-band fix; the first SOL run, -94%, is void). Negative before costs on both. Walk-forward beat holding in 0 of 7 (ETH) and 0 of 6 (SOL) windows; on ETH it beat 19% of random-entry paths (95% needed). Robustness not run (Luke): it can't change a test-1 failure and would add about 30 trials.
